exposure: Children >6 months old born by caesarean section
cohort: 2496 children under 24 months of age who visited the University Hospital Sharjah with acute respiratory tract infections between January 1st 2018 and January 1st 2020
finding: The incidence of RSV infection among children under 2 years old who presented with ARTIs was 18.79%, with a peak season between October and December.
mod_finding: Children >6 months of age who were born by cesarean section were more prone to RSV infection.
